claims.statement: Creation declares FPT/GHEC/GHES; read access suffices where issues enabled, unlike quickstart write prerequisite. Administrators can disable issues; EMU enterprise-only qualifier and operation-specific metadata permissions still apply.
Repository creation chooses template or available blank issue and explicit title/body/submission. Blank fallback is not authorization to bypass disabled blank intake or required form validation.
FPT/GHEC duplicate suggestions start after title/body hundred-character threshold and show up to three existing issues; suggestions nonblocking, not audited equivalence or forced deduplication.

Comment entry creates new issue with origin snippet and explicitly chosen destination. Source paragraph includes Create then reusable Submit sequence; exact UI interaction requires verification, not presumed atomic two-step creation.
Code entry creates issue only in same repository and captures chosen line/range snippet. Snippet identity alone does not pin immutable revision or substantiate defect correctness.

Discussion entry requires triage, copies post body and retains labels without deleting/converting original discussion. Copy differs reverse issue-to-discussion conversion and carries separate identity/custody.

Projects creation modal explicitly selects repository, metadata and create; grouped-view origin assigns group field value. Project context cannot authorize arbitrary repository write or establish default precedence.
Tasklist-to-issue conversion is FPT/GHEC conditional; text task state and newly created issue remain distinct identities and not verified acceptance.

URL parameters title/body/labels/milestone/assignees/projects/template require equivalent action permissions. Invalid or unauthorized URL yields404 and oversize414; errors cannot be interpreted as missing compliant state.

Template URL parameter supports ISSUE_TEMPLATE subdirectories in root/docs/.github; FPT/GHEC custom form text prefilling is distinct from organization issue-field values which detailed field guide excludes via URL/template.

CLI creation title/body skips prompts; metadata/type/parent flags require compatible CLI and exact targets. Dependency creation conditional FPT/GHEC; no atomic multi-operation guarantee or recovery receipt provided.

Copilot-conditioned cloud creation is preview; natural language/screenshots and IDE MCP produce proposed issue metadata, not correct or accepted policy by default. No agent/action launch or screenshot disclosure performed.
